hemera.name: Hemera Estate

reviews: Great wine tasting experience here with a really great lady who was knowledgeable and funny as well. The Grenache Rose was very nice as were all the wines we tasted. The atmosphere was laidback and enjoyable!

We savoured a relaxed wine-tasting experience with the well-versed Lisa who related the history of Hemera Estate while pouring our tasting choices. We purchased a refreshing Grenache Rose as well as Grenache from their oldest vines (1912) and not disappointed.
Can only agree with other reviewers, the tasting and hospitality by Lisa was a superb experience. Loved the wines and purchased some GSM and old vine Shiraz, delicious!

What a cost setup. Came for the wine and chocolate tasting and it was such a fun experience. Rachel was a great host, and took the time to explain to us the history of Hemera and the Barossa. In terms of the wine, all the Shiraz variety were beautiful, as was the 2017 Riesling.

The tasting room is stunning, filled with many iconic award
